artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc. For an integer $n\ge 2$, let $V_n$ be the class of complex polynomials
$$P_n(z)=z+a_2 z^2+a_3 z^3+\cdots+a_n z^n$$
such that $P_n$ is univalent in $\mathbb{D}$ and the inverse function $P_n^{-1}$ (defined on $P_n(\mathbb{D})$) admits a univalent extension to all of $\mathbb{D}$; in other words, both $P_n$ and $P_n^{-1}$ are univalent on $\mathbb{D}$ (so $P_n$ is bi-univalent in $\mathbb{D}$).

Determine the exact values of
$$\max_{P_n\in V_n}|a_2|\qquad\text{and}\qquad\max_{P_n\in V_n}|a_n|$$
as functions of $n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Coefficient bounds for bi-univalent functions (Lewin, Brannan–Clunie, Brannan–Taha) remain a long-standing open area; the sharp values of $\max|a_2|$ and $\max|a_n|$ over the polynomial class $V_n$ of bi-univalent polynomials of degree $n$ have not been established. Recent literature continues to give only partial estimates for various subclasses.

status_evidence.title: On some classes of univalent polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Studies coefficient problems for univalent polynomials; sharp bounds for bi-univalent polynomial classes are not given.
status_evidence.claim: Coefficient extrema for bi-univalent polynomial classes are not resolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Faber polynomial coefficient bounds for a subclass of bi-univalent functions
status_evidence.snippet: Provides only estimates (not sharp values) for coefficients of bi-univalent functions.
status_evidence.claim: Coefficient bounds for bi-univalent classes remain open in general.
